scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,front -c green,cyan "pnpm -F @tormenta20/engine-go dev" "pnpm -F frontend dev"
scripts.dev:nest: concurrently -k -n t20,nest,front -c gray,yellow,cyan "pnpm -F @tormenta20/t20-data dev" "pnpm -F backend dev" "API_TARGET=http://localhost:3000 pnpm -F frontend dev"
scripts.dev:app: concurrently -k -n back,front -c yellow,cyan "pnpm -F backend dev" "API_TARGET=http://localhost:3000 pnpm -F frontend dev"
scripts.prisma:migrate: pnpm --filter backend exec prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:migrate: mkdir -p data && DATABASE_URL=file:../data/app.db pnpm --filter backend exec prisma migrate deploy
